notes.title: Deep reboot!
notes.content:
Hello friends,

As you know, we have been experimenting with the mobile version of the [b]Zombotron Re-Boot[/b] game and have come to the conclusion that we should do a [b]complete reboot[/b] of the game and not focus on mobile players.

[b]What does this mean?[/b]

We have decided to abandon the casual stylization of the game and make the graphics more stylized and dark.

[previewyoutube=kogF5Icad5I;full][/previewyoutube]
We have decided to abandon the chibi characters and make them more realistic proportions. We have made the characters' arms and legs longer - this not only changes the perception of the game, but also simplifies the creation of many animations and equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740297/12d3eaacc6de4326834da9938459ecd7811d662f.png[/img]
We have decided to abandon linear levels in favor of a conditionally open world in which you can move in any direction to explore the game world. In addition, we plan to add some metroidvania elements to the game. We have noticed that many players like to explore the game and find various mysterious places. In this way, we hope to make the game deeper and diversify the endless action with additional activities and calm locations.

We also want to do a lot of work on the mistakes and make a full-fledged finished story that will better reveal the events taking place in the game. We have prepared a small teaser for the introductory cut-scene, which you can watch right now!

[previewyoutube=ThDiU-RAX5A;full][/previewyoutube]
I really hope that we made the right decisions and you will support us on this difficult path! We will keep you informed about the development of the full version of the game and show how the game will change further.

- Ant

notes.title: The New Year update!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we have done a lot of work and released the New Year update for Zombotron Re-Boot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740297/015fc9038e4b13e366d8b6e695dde7d0e861330f.png[/img]

What's new?

✨ Added new challenging levels in which you have to get to the last floor;
✨ In the new levels, you can find three new holiday hats;
✨ Fixed some old known bugs and made new ones!

Are you ready for new challenges? Can you reach the 25th floor!?

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
Have a wonderful holidays!

- Ant.
